title: Subscription billing support
description: Billing answers that check the account first and never promise refunds without the policy.

train.prompt: A customer says they were charged twice this month.
train.completion: Check the account's payment history for duplicate charges. If one is a duplicate, refund it and tell the customer when it will appear.

train.prompt: A customer wants a refund for an annual plan bought 3 months ago.
train.completion: Check the refund policy for annual plans. If it allows only a partial refund, explain the amount before processing anything.

train.prompt: How do I cancel my subscription?
train.completion: You can cancel in Account settings under Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

train.prompt: A customer's card was declined and their account is now paused.
train.completion: Ask them to update the card in Billing settings. The account reactivates automatically once the payment succeeds.

train.prompt: Can I give a customer a free month because the service was down?
train.completion: Check the outage credit policy. Apply the credit it allows, and ask a supervisor before giving anything more.

train.prompt: A customer wants an invoice with their company VAT number.
train.completion: Ask them to add the VAT number in Billing settings, then regenerate the invoice. Past invoices can be reissued by the billing team.

train.prompt: A customer upgraded mid-month. Why is the charge so odd?
train.completion: Upgrades are prorated. Explain they paid the difference for the rest of the month, and show the line items on the invoice.

train.prompt: A customer asks to pay by bank transfer instead of card.
train.completion: Bank transfer is available on annual plans above the minimum amount. Check eligibility, then send the transfer details from the billing team.

train.prompt: A customer says they cancelled but were still charged.
train.completion: Check the cancellation date against the renewal date. If they cancelled before renewal, refund the charge and confirm the cancellation.

train.prompt: A user wants to know their next billing date.
train.completion: The next billing date is shown in Account settings under Billing. I can also check it for you after verifying your account email.

train.prompt: A customer asks for a discount if they stay another year.
train.completion: Check the current retention offers in the billing tool. Only offer a discount listed there or approved by a supervisor.

train.prompt: A customer disputes a charge with their bank.
train.completion: Do not refund separately while a dispute is open, to avoid paying twice. Send the case to the billing team with the payment ID.

val.prompt: A customer wants a full refund after using the product for a year.
val.completion: Explain the refund policy. Refunds after the refund window are not standard, so offer to cancel the renewal instead.

val.prompt: Why was I charged tax this month when I was not before?
val.completion: Tax is based on your billing address. Check whether the address changed, and point them to the tax line on the invoice.

val.prompt: Can I move my plan to a different email account?
val.completion: Verify ownership of both emails, then the support team can transfer the subscription between accounts.

val.prompt: My payment failed but money left my bank account.
val.completion: Check the payment status. A failed payment hold is usually released by the bank within a few days. Ask for the bank reference if it is not.
